integrity: The gap-rank formula is derived from an exact prefix-sum recurrence and checked by direct enumeration and an independent dynamic program; moments and row sums are separately checked.
scientific_limitations: Specific to Dunn expansions of finite Gödel chains.
The classical ballot triangle is prior mathematics; originality is only the modal-algebraic identification and resulting law.
Older refined plane-partition literature may contain an equivalent combinatorial coefficient theorem.
title: Catalan-triangle gap law for Dunn modal expansions of finite Gödel chains
